title: Toremiru
description: A trade-review and learning web service for FX traders. Record stop-loss, take-profit, reasoning and rule adherence, spot your habits with entry-time charts and stats, and export everything for AI analysis in one click.
overviewDesc: Even after many trades, "why did I lose?" and "when do I actually win?" blur when you rely on memory. So I'm building Toremiru, a service for recording and reviewing my own FX trades. By saving your entry reasoning, emotions and whether you followed your rules, you can see results in pips, yen and R-multiples, and revisit the situation with charts from 1-minute to daily bars with EMAs overlaid at the moment of entry. It is designed around a loop: paste all your data into AI for improvement ideas, turn them into rules, and verify their effect over ten trades.

highlights.title: Review with charts as of the entry
highlights.desc: On the trade detail page, switch from 1-minute to daily bars and overlay EMAs plus TP, SL and entry lines. Post-entry price movement, maximum favorable/adverse excursion (MFE/MAE) and side-by-side timeframes let you re-examine your decision calmly.

highlights.title: Turn habits into numbers with stats and rule checks
highlights.desc: Beyond win rate, profit factor, average R, cumulative R and max drawdown, it breaks results down by session, reasoning and weekday, plus rule-adherence rate. Small samples are flagged "needs verification", and results when you kept or broke a rule can be compared.

highlights.title: Export built for AI analysis and blogging
highlights.desc: Export every trade in a form that is easy to paste into AI and manage the suggested improvements as rules. For blogging, it outputs a zip with chart images, connecting directly to my blog, "FX Trader Growth Diary".

timeline.desc: After finding my post-trade reflection relied too much on gut feeling, I decided to build a service for recording, reviewing and improving. I prepared designs and an implementation brief for AI, then started from a project template.

timeline.flag: Built recording, auto-calculation and CSV import
timeline.desc: Implemented trade entry and exit input, automatic pips/yen/R-multiple calculation and automatic rule-adherence checks. Also added bulk import of Rakuten FX execution-history CSVs (Shift_JIS, multiple files).

timeline.flag: Set up charts and price data
timeline.desc: Built an API that aggregates 1-minute bars into any timeframe, plus the chart components. Switched price data to CSVs exported from MT5 and dropped automatic scraping that was problematic under the terms of service.

timeline.flag: Built stats, rule verification and export
timeline.desc: Added a stats page filterable by period, rule-adherence and effect verification, an export for AI analysis and a step-card user guide.

timeline.flag: Landing page, rename and blog integration
timeline.desc: Created a landing page that flies through a three.js candlestick city and features real screenshots. Renamed the app "Toremiru" and implemented zip export for the blog (contract v1).

screenshots.title: Trade detail
screenshots.caption: Entry-time bars from 1-minute to daily with EMAs overlaid, TP, exit and entry lines and post-entry movement, plus maximum favorable and adverse excursion.

screenshots.title: Side-by-side timeframes
screenshots.caption: View 1-minute and 1-hour bars together, with the plan (entry, SL, TP, RR) and reasoning notes overlaid on the chart.

screenshots.title: Rule check
screenshots.caption: Check your rules before placing a trade, and compare average R when you followed them versus when you broke them.

screenshots.title: Stats
screenshots.caption: Key metrics such as win rate, PF, average R and max losing streak, plus daily growth and cumulative R with a max-drawdown band, by period.

screenshots.title: Weekly review
screenshots.caption: See the week's daily R, rule adherence and emotion tags, and how much plan-following exits would have changed the result.
